rules.notes: Star rating (0-5, half-star steps) = location + salary + stack + mission + interaction. Location: remote=1, hybrid=0.5, on-site=0 (inferred from the Location field). Salary: matches target (>= minSalaryK)=1, unknown/not listed=0.5, below target=0 (inferred from the salary.high field). Tech stack match: 75%+=1, 35-75%=0.5, under 35%=0 (set manually, per activity). Company mission / industry fit: good or liked industry=1, neutral company=0.5, mission I do not support (e.g. surveillance, weapons, war contractors)=0 (set manually, per activity). Human interaction: any recruiter/hiring-manager call, interview, or networking referral=1, online application only with no contact yet=0 (inferred from Person contacted, Result, and the activity/result-detail text). Inactive activities are always 0 stars regardless of the above.
